informal_statement:
If
\[
d(-z)=d(z)
\]
for \(-1\leq z\leq1\), and \(d\) is strictly increasing on \([0,1]\), then \(t\mapsto4[d(2t-1)-d(t)]\) is nonincreasing on \([0,1/3]\).
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:345-360`: Evenness is required only on the stated closed interval, and the strict-increase premise is retained in the reflected order argument.
